quiz.question: What is excess property checking?
options: A value satisfying all member types.
A named collection of constants with enum-specific typing.
A value compatible with at least one member type.
An additional static check applied to certain object literals to detect unexpected properties.
quiz.explanation: An additional static check applied to certain object literals to detect unexpected properties.

quiz.question: Why does a direct object assignment fail but assignment through a variable succeed?
options: To represent impossible values and detect unhandled cases.
Interviewer: How can TypeScript detect an incomplete permission registry?
Interfaces support merging; aliases support a broader range of type expressions.
Fresh object literals receive additional excess property checks.
quiz.explanation: Fresh object literals receive additional excess property checks. Ordinary variable assignment primarily follows structural compatibility.

quiz.question: What is the difference between as and satisfies?
options: Prevents a type position from contributing to inference.
Captures a type inside a conditional pattern.
Removes null and undefined from a type.
as asserts a type interpretation, while satisfies checks compatibility without simply replacing the expression's resulting type.
quiz.explanation: as asserts a type interpretation, while satisfies checks compatibility without simply replacing the expression's resulting type.

quiz.question: Does assigning a private data object to a public interface remove sensitive fields?
options: Interviewer: Your agent supports 30 tools with different input and output types.
Interviewer: Your LLM generates the correct tool name but incorrect argument properties.
Interviewer: Your execution budget is implemented using a private class field, but users exceed their limits when the service scales horizontally.
No. TypeScript types do not change runtime object contents.
quiz.explanation: No. TypeScript types do not change runtime object contents. This is arguably the most important concept in this entire module for production AI systems.

quiz.question: What is an index signature?
options: Removes null and undefined from a type.
A type representing a specific value.
An operator checking compatibility while retaining useful inferred type information.
A type declaration describing permitted dynamic property keys and their corresponding value types.
quiz.explanation: A type declaration describing permitted dynamic property keys and their corresponding value types.
